GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (30 Apr 47) LS-R
(SCAPIN - 1640)
APO 500
30 April 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminal.
1. Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government dated 11 Feb 47, file AG 000.5 (11 Feb 47) LS-R, (SCAPIN 1517), wherein the Imperial Japanese Government was directed to deliver one SHIMIZU, Shigeo, Civilian, to the Commanding General, EIGHTH Army at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest possible date, is amended to delete said SHIMIZU's name for the reason that SHIMIZU is the same suspect whose name appeared on L. S. Apprehension Memorandum dated 5 February 1947, (SCAPIN 1506). This name appears as the sixth name on Page No. 4 of the Memorandum dated 11 Feb 47.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
